title: JANUS Engine — dedicated research-branch manifest
purpose: Structured index for JANUS Engine architecture, simulations, literature crawls and staged validation without prematurely merging research conclusions into main.

branching_policy.rule: Existing canonical JANUS Engine records remain inherited at data/ paths; branch-specific gates, simulations and research live under projects/janus-engine/.

MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.flow: water -> POMS artificial gill -> low-pO2 recirculating cathode gas -> PEMFC -> electricity -> auxiliaries/battery
MODE_A_DIRECT_GILL_PEMFC.reason: avoids bulk O2/N2 separation, N2 service and LOX during first ignition

MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.flow: dissolved-gas extraction -> conditioning -> O2/N2 separation -> O2 use/storage + N2 cooling/regeneration/inert cascade -> optional cryogenic branch

latest_findings.startup_lesson: self-drive is a transient state transition; readiness is state convergence rather than t=0 behavior
latest_findings.scale_management: Use low-hardness initial fill, candidate low-dose anti-adhesion chemistry only after compatibility tests, low-adhesion wall engineering, rotating near-wall Axle/wipers, centrifugal solids transport and removable crystal traps / washable filters.
latest_findings.wall_surface_result: Use a dual-zone surface strategy: hard smooth low-adhesion coating on repeatedly wiped tracks, and durable superhydrophobic/low-surface-energy coating only on non-contact wall zones unless wear testing proves otherwise.
latest_findings.vane_energy_result: If the same local pump supplies the pressure drop across an Axle vane, recovered shaft power is always smaller than added pump power for realistic efficiencies. Therefore vanes are primarily anti-scale/flow-conditioning elements; external-current energy recovery is a separate case and must charge drag.
latest_findings.crystal_trap_result: Normalized sensitivity shows strong multiplicative benefit when trap capture and Axle scraping are combined, but actual eta_trap and eta_scraper remain measurement gates rather than assumed hardware performance.
latest_findings.battery_result: Admit an externally precharged bidirectional battery as startup reservoir, transient buffer and surplus accumulator. It must never be counted as generated energy; self-drive requires the charger disconnected and battery energy non-decreasing over the stabilized hold window.
latest_findings.mode_A_battery_screen: For a first low-power demonstrator, 50-100 Wh is a plausible screening buffer envelope for hours-scale startup at single-digit/low-tens-of-watts deficit, but final capacity remains measurement-driven.
latest_findings.calcium_product_boundary: Recovered solids are recorded as CaCO3-rich mineral product until composition and use-specific qualification justify a stronger material claim.

current_project_state.dominant_boss: Measure long-duration coupled oxygen flux, auxiliary watts, startup energy, wall adhesion/wear and calcium partitioning under real water chemistry.

next_actions: Run A0/A1/A2/A3 long-hold factorial for scale partitioning and self-cleaning.
Run bare versus hard-low-adhesion versus superhydrophobic wall coupons under representative chemistry and repeated wiper cycles.
Instrument startup battery Wh in/out and freeze capacity from measured P_deficit(t), not from analogy.
Use battery surplus charging as a diagnostic: only after reserve SoC is stable/restored may persistent power be declared exportable.
Replace normalized trap/scraper/coating parameters with measured values before lifetime or maintenance-interval claims.
